examples.quote: The README links to a new sensitivity section in the existing fit-diagnostics article. It recommends a separate ridge-2 fit for extreme or unstable ordinary between-unit loadings, describes what the Gaussian prior penalises, and explains why a healthy penalised Hessian is insufficient. The article reports the four-scale availability counts, paired recovery example, separate positive/zero-effect coverage, Monte Carlo uncertainty and persistent Poisson undercoverage. Long and wide calls fit the same example and print their covariance difference. A portable aggregate/method record, decision entry and EXT-31 addendum retain the evidence without promoting general calibration. No package source, formal default or runtime behaviour changed.
